notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.6 - 19.01.2025
notes.content:
New:


     
Added a helpful tip for those who might need a little extra guidance (we see you, game journalists). Now you'll know that you can exit through the screen edge to appear on the other side. You're welcome!

Community:


   We've launched the official speedrunning community! Think you can break the game? Prove it! Check out the current world record here: 
Gorf the Frog on speedrun.com
[previewyoutube=tCxsj7QpCtY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: HOTFIX 1.0.5.1
notes.content:
Bug Fixes


 Fixed an issue introduced in the previous hotfix that prevented improving experience scores without also improving time.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.5
notes.content:
Fixes:
 - Cutscenes no longer overrides acces to level in replay section
 - The replay section now updates your time and score only if you beat or match your best experience score, ensuring alignment with the intended design.

notes.title: 1.0.4 Update is live!
